text: I've been thinking the world would be better if I just wasn't in it.
I wrote letters to my parents in case I'm not here next week.
I keep looking up how many pills it would take.
I don't see myself making it to my birthday.
Honestly I just want to sleep and never wake up.
I stood on the terrace last night and thought about jumping.
I've started cutting again, my arms are covered.
If I fail this exam I'm going to take my own life.
Nobody would even notice if I disappeared for good.
I have a plan for how I'd do it, I just haven't picked a day.
I'm so tired of being alive.
I feel like ending everything after results.
My uncle touches me when nobody is home and I'm scared to tell anyone.
My father hits me with a belt when my marks are low.
Main ab jeena nahi chahta.
Kabhi kabhi lagta hai khud ko khatam kar doon.
Result ke baad main suicide kar lunga.
Mujhe marne ka mann karta hai.
Papa mujhe roz maarte hain, ghar jaane se darr lagta hai.
Sab chhod ke chala jaunga is duniya se.
Neend ki goliyan jama kar raha hoon.
Mere jaane ke baad sab khush rahenge.
मैं अब जीना नहीं चाहता।
मुझे मरने का मन करता है।
मैं खुद को नुकसान पहुँचाना चाहती हूँ।
पापा मुझे रोज़ मारते हैं।
मैं आत्महत्या के बारे में सोच रहा हूँ।
इस दुनिया से चले जाना चाहता हूँ।
I could just die of embarrassment, I tripped on stage.
My phone battery is dead again.
That movie was so sad, the hero dies at the end.
I'm dead tired after the coaching class.
The physics paper was murder.
I want to kill it at the interview tomorrow.
Ye assignment toh jaan le lega.
Hum log hanste hanste mar gaye.
मैं थक कर चूर हूँ।
